lines.text: Many learners say: He doesn't likes it.
After doesn't, the verb has no s.

data.why: After doesn't, the verb has no s.

native.hook: doesn't のあとに s をつけてない？
native.tip: doesn't がすでに三単現の s を持っているので、動詞は原形に。
native.caption: “He doesn't likes it.”と言っていませんか？😅 否定文では doesn't が三人称単数を担当します。そのため like は s のない原形になります。 “He doesn't like it.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“like”。doesn't のあとは原形。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.hook: Do you add s after doesn't?
en.tip: Doesn't already carries the s. Use the plain verb: like.
en.caption: Do you say “He doesn't likes it.”? 😅 In negatives, doesn't handles the third person, so the verb stays plain. The natural way is “He doesn't like it.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
